entries.german: Otto erneuert auf Wunsch seiner Großmutter Adelheid und des Erzbischofs Willigis, sowie zu seinem und seiner Eltern Seelenheil die Schenkung der zwei königlichen Höfe Calbe im Nordthüringgau und Rosenburg im Gau Serimunt, die sein Großvater (DO. I. 278) und sein Vater (DO. II. 82) der erzbischöflichen Kirche von Magdeburg gegeben hatten, und verordnet, daß der Ertrag dieser Höfe dem Domkapitel zustehen solle (... votum et interventum dilectae aviae nostre Athelheidis ... nec non fidelis nostri Uuilligisi ... pro remedio animae nostrae nostrorumque parentum illas duas praedictas curtes Calua scilicet et Rosburg ... noviter ... corroboramus et ad opus vel usum fratrum deo sanctoque Mauritio in Magdaburg servientium deputamus ...). ‒ Hildibaldus canc. vice Uuilligisi archicap.; nach Vorlage von DO. II. 82 und DO. III. 10 verfaßt und geschrieben von LI; MF., SI. 2. „Si ecclesiis dei de nostrae maiestatis regia munificentia”.
entries.english: At the request of his grandmother Adelheid and Archbishop Willigis, and for the salvation of his own soul and those of his parents, Otto renews the grant of the two royal estates of Calbe in the North Thuringian district and Rosenburg in the district of Serimunt, which his grandfather (DO. I. 278) and father (DO. II. 82) had given to the archiepiscopal church of Magdeburg. He decrees that the income from these estates is to belong to the cathedral chapter. (The charter states that, at the request and intervention of his dear grandmother Adelheid and his faithful Willigis, and for the salvation of his and his parents' souls, Otto reconfirms the two estates Calua and Rosburg and assigns them for the use of the brothers serving God and St. Maurice at Magdeburg.) Hildibald, chancellor, acting for Willigis, archchaplain; composed and written by LI after the exemplars DO. II. 82 and DO. III. 10; MF., SI. 2. “If, through the royal generosity of our majesty, [we grant something] to the churches of God.”
